boundary: Two already exposed natural base tasks only; removed variants are development interventions, not additional D0/Discovery samples. No protected tasks, code generation, outcomes, Pair or manuscript changes.
evaluation: Separate proposal/review, graph construction/repair, candidate state, local semantic review, renderer and independent verifier. Source audit checks original non-target behavior, shared support, condition/order preservation and ambiguity. Approval is not gold; all failures/unknowns retained. Inverse ADD is the same paired source contrast, not an independent natural task. No population reliability estimate or security effect claim.
model: Fresh inherited Codex contexts; exact model snapshot and seed unavailable.
procedure: Per task: one fresh model background proposal; existing factor semantic review once. Accepted proposal freezes one catalog shared by both arms. Independently construct each original and clause-deleted source; at most one compiler-only repair, then one ordinary source review and at most one existing local patch. One existing scope assessment per completed graph. If both arms retain adequate scopes, one fresh model review sees the paired prompts/graphs and supplies correspondence plus local support for both directions. Execute existing reviewed renderer and independent verifier; no semantic resampling or root-authored replacement judgments. Stop dependent stages on rejected/unresolved prerequisites, preserving why. Use existing replays for retained model messages.
purpose: On the two prior natural tasks, test model-selected independent background and model-authored local support through actual REMOVE and inverse ADD under one frozen vocabulary.
